## Handover Summary — Provisions & Cost of Risk

Rate × exposure model validated for ECL, provisions and other impairment.

## Key Decisions
• Cost of risk planned at 24 bps for Q4 (from 21 bps) for Stage 2 migration risk
• Provisions run-rate set at EUR 4.0M for FY2027 after two settled claims
• Spanish Day-1 ECL recalibration submitted for model validation

## Recommendation for Admin Expenses
Credit costs are small relative to the cost base — the efficiency ratio is the bigger lever. Hand over to the cost-centre owners.
